name: chat-inventory
description: A side pane, In this chat, that lists the to-do list, the connectors used (with a call count and a tool breakdown for each), the files read or changed, and the skills this chat used.

autoOpen.title: Open by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the In this chat pane the first time a chat uses a tool, a file or a skill.

hideConnectors.title: Hide these connectors
hideConnectors.description: Names to leave out of the Connectors list, separated by commas (for example: Terminal, Visualize). Matches the connector's name.

extraCliTools.title: Extra command line tools
extraCliTools.description: Command line tools to count as connectors when Claude runs them in Bash. Write command=Name pairs separated by commas (for example: firecrawl=Firecrawl, aws=AWS).
